ModMetaData.name: RandomPlusPlus
ModMetaData.author: TrevorS, mastertea
ModMetaData.description:
RandomPlusPlus is a fork of RandomPlus, with the reroll search rewritten and several filter bugs fixed.
Set a specification for your starting colonists, then hit randomize. It keeps rerolling until a pawn matches, or until it reaches your reroll limit.
Filter on skill levels and passions, total skill points, traits (required, excluded, or "any N of these"), age, gender, health conditions and work capability.
WHY THIS FORK EXISTS
The original RandomPlus by mastertea still works, and this fork owes it everything. It has not been updated since June 2025, though, and the following were all sitting in it unfixed:
- A gender filter could never be satisfied on the fast reroll setting. Rolling for one would spend the entire reroll limit and then hand back a pawn of the wrong gender anyway. - The pawn you kept wore apparel and carried a weapon rolled for the previous candidate rather than for itself. - "Count only highest attack skill" read the wrong two skills as soon as any other mod added a skill of its own. - Asking for more traits from the pool than you had put in it produced a filter no pawn could ever satisfy, which quietly consumed the whole reroll limit on every randomize. - If your saved filter file could not be read, it was deleted. It is now moved aside so the presets can be recovered.
Beyond those, the search itself was rewritten: a rejected pawn now regenerates only the parts a filter actually reads instead of a whole pawn, and the mod asks Harmony which other mods have patched pawn generation rather than checking for one by name, so it takes the safe path automatically when it needs to.
The search also no longer freezes the game. It runs across frames, the card shows a live reroll counter and the candidates ticking past at a readable pace, and a Stop button ends it early - keeping the pawn it was on, fully finished. The Filter button turns green while a filter is active, so you always know whether randomize will search or just roll once.
Supports RimWorld 1.6 and 1.5, both built from the same source, so the fixes above apply to both. If you are on 1.4 or earlier, use the original mod instead.
Original mod: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1434137894 Source code: https://github.com/TrevorS/RandomPlusPlus
Do not run this alongside the original RandomPlus. Both replace the same randomize button, and the two are declared incompatible.
